raw:
Challenge the **80-hour replacement installation downtime** first.

It is the direct trade-off against your next-quarter aim: a replacement’s higher assumed reliability (**98%**) and capacity (**6,500 orders/quarter**) only help after it is ready. The 80-hour figure is an Olumi assumption, not evidence, and a commissioning overrun could materially change the case.

Also challenge the assumed **£40,000 replacement cost**: it exactly meets your cap, leaving no allowance for installation, contingency, or associated works.
